hardness.label: Moderately Hard
hardness.intro: The City of Minneapolis measured an average of 94 mg/L total hardness (about 5.5 GPG) in 2025 after softening its river water at the plant. Click a community to see what that means for your home.
hardness.reportNote: The City of Minneapolis 2025 record lists total hardness at an average of 94 mg/L within a range of 80 to 113 mg/L (4.7 to 6.6 GPG). The USGS rates 61 to 120 mg/L as moderately hard. These are readings at the plant, so a tap can differ.
hardness.footnote: Hardness is the City of Minneapolis plant average for 2025, not a reading at your tap. Suburbs that receive Minneapolis water may blend other sources, so check your water bill for the provider; a free water test shows your own number.
